record.context_brief: Defect below Delta squared in graph squares
record.original_question: For each integer t, does there exist a threshold Delta_t such that every graph G with maximum degree Delta(G) > Delta_t satisfies omega(G^2) <= Delta(G)^2 - t? If such a threshold exists, can the same conclusion be strengthened from the clique number of G^2 to the coloring, list-coloring, painting, or Alon-Tarsi parameters of G^2, namely chi(G^2), chi_l(G^2), chi_p(G^2), or chi_AT(G^2)?

evidence.quote: Question 4. For each integer t, does there exist a constant ∆t such that all graphs G with ∆ > ∆t satisfy ω^2(G) 6 ∆2 − t? Can this conclusion be strengthened further to (i) χ2(G) 6 ∆2 − t, (ii) χ2_ℓ(G) 6 ∆2 − t, (iii) χ2_p(G) 6 ∆2 − t, or even (iv) χ2_AT(G) 6 ∆2 − t?

For each integer t, there exists a constant ∆t such that all G with ∆ > ∆t satisfy ω^2(G) 6 ∆2 − t. This conclusion can be strengthened further to (i) χ2(G) 6 ∆2 − t, (ii) χ2_ℓ(G) 6 ∆2 − t, (iii) χ2_p(G) 6 ∆2 − t, and even (iv) χ2_AT(G) 6 ∆2 − t. This is Question 4.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let G be a finite simple graph with maximum degree Δ(G). The square G² of G is the graph on the same vertex set in which two distinct vertices are adjacent if and only if their distance in G is at most 2. For a graph H write:
• ω(H) for its clique number;
• χ(H) for its chromatic number;
• χ_ℓ(H) for its list chromatic number (choice number);
• χ_p(H) for its paint number (online list chromatic number);
• χ_AT(H) for its Alon–Tarsi number.

Recall that ω(H) ≤ χ(H) ≤ χ_ℓ(H) ≤ χ_p(H) ≤ χ_AT(H) for every graph H, and that for any graph G one has ω(G²) ≤ Δ(G)² + 1.

Question. For every integer t ≥ 0, does there exist a constant Δ_t such that every graph G with Δ(G) > Δ_t satisfies
                 ω(G²) ≤ Δ(G)² − t ?
If yes, can this conclusion be strengthened, under the same hypothesis Δ(G) > Δ_t (possibly with a larger threshold), to each of:
 (i) χ(G²) ≤ Δ(G)² − t,
 (ii) χ_ℓ(G²) ≤ Δ(G)² − t,
 (iii) χ_p(G²) ≤ Δ(G)² − t,
 (iv) χ_AT(G²) ≤ Δ(G)² − t ?
artifact.category_tag: Graph coloring and squares of graphs
artifact.status_search_result: The question concerning the defect below Δ² for clique, chromatic, list-chromatic, paint, and Alon–Tarsi numbers of squares of graphs appears to remain open. Related recent work on cliques in squares of planar graphs and bounded-mad graphs (2023) addresses restricted classes only and does not resolve the general question.

status_evidence.title: Bounding Clique Size in Squares of Planar Graphs
status_evidence.snippet: If G is a plane graph with Δ(G)≥36, then ω(G²)≤⌊3/2·Δ(G)⌋+1.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work addresses ω(G²) bounds only in restricted classes (planar), not the general defect-below-Δ² problem.

status_evidence.title: Cliques in Squares of Graphs with Maximum Average Degree less than 4
status_evidence.snippet: Results on ω(G²) for graphs with bounded maximum average degree.
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress exists only for restricted graph classes.
